items.markdown:
The Destination Thailand Visa (DTV) is a 5-year multiple-entry long-stay visa for remote workers, digital nomads, and soft-power participants (such as Muay Thai or cooking course attendees), costing around £300 or 10,000 THB.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/destination-thailand-visa) [[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/destination-thailand-visa)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rb02sdspl50)[[3]](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/)[[4]](https://traveldave.co.uk/thai-digital-nomad-visa-dtv-destination-thailand-visa/)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E3C2z8aIYqs&t=20)

Key Features

- **Duration:** Valid for 5 years, granting up to 180 days per entry with an option to extend once per entry for another 180 days.
- **Eligible Groups:** Remote workers, freelancers, digital nomads, and people taking part in Thai cultural activities or medical treatments.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/destination-thailand-visa) [[1]](https://immigrationconnection.co.uk/services/thailand-digital-nomad-visa/)

Core Requirements

- **Financial Proof:** Bank balance showing at least £11,000 or 500,000 THB.
- **Employment / Activity Proof:** Employment contract, corporate portfolio, or registration letter for an approved Thai activity/course.
- **Application:** Must be submitted online via the [Official Website of Thailand Electronic Visa](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/) from outside Thailand.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/destination-thailand-visa) [[1]](https://www.thaievisa.go.th/visa/dtv-visa)

If you would like, please share:

- Your **nationality / passport country** 
- Your specific **reason for travel** (remote work vs. cultural course)

I can give you more details on the exact embassy documents needed.
